description: Agent Construction: submit a completion certificate or punch list record with the contract scope and the inspection record as provided: the record with its kind (a certificate or a punch list), who issued it, its date, what it states about the work as a whole (complete, substantially complete or incomplete), the completion day it states and each item with its id, the scope item it reads, description, status (complete or open) and day completed; the scope list with the completion day the contract schedules and each scope item with its id and description; and optionally the inspection record with the inspector, the day inspected and each item with its id, scope item, description and result (passed, failed, open or not inspected). The signed report gives the record, the scope list and the inspection record, each listed item matched to its scope item, the scope items unaccounted for, the items marked complete against their inspection results, and the dates, and counts them, and names a misreported record: a scope item the record lists neither complete nor open, an item marked complete that the inspection record shows failed or open, the work stated complete with items open, and an item dated complete after the record; then a listed item outside the scope, an item marked complete with no inspection result, an inspection item missing from the record and a completion after the scheduled day, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No inspection record, no listed items, no scope items, or an item marked complete with no day leaves the record unverified. Items meet by the scope item they name, then by their words. This check reports whether the record matches the scope list; it never judges whether the work is sound or safe. Beside it, wever_realty-inspection-check reads a property inspection report against the summary made from it, wever_deliverable-check reads delivered work against a job’s acceptance criteria, and wever_commitment-closure-check reads the commitments an agent marked done against their closure evidence, while the completion check reads construction items completed and open against the contract scope and the inspection record. Verdict build_completion_misreported, build_completion_partial, build_completion_unverified or build_completion_faithful. POST /api/build-completion-check. Reads the construction paperwork supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads consistency between documents only, with no structural, engineering or safety judgment, building-code compliance determination, valuation of work performed or legal advice on contracts, liens or permits, and the paperwork stays in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Construction reads supplied construction paperwork for consistency between documents: a building permit, a contractor license record, a bid, a construction contract, a change order, a lien waiver, a completion certificate or punch list record, and a payment application. Beside it, wever_workorder-create and the other wever_workorder tools and wever_agent-work-order-exchange are the action layer that creates, funds, delivers and releases work orders, while this family moves nothing and executes nothing and only reads paperwork; wever_agent-escrow-lite holds and releases escrowed funds, and escrow stays there; and the Agent Real Estate checks such as wever_realty-title-check read property records by parcel and address, not a project’s construction paperwork. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-construction-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-construction/.
